title: Addition cancels on the right
statement: For naturals a, b, c: if a + c = b + c then a = b.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.add_right_cancel : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> ((x3 : Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.add x0 x2) (AxNat.add x1 x2)) -> Eq.{1} AxNat x0 x1))))

evidence.supports: Nat.add_right_cancel is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.

evidence.notes: `build_nat_prelude` admits this theorem only through the trusted kernel gate, so a successful build IS the type-check; the command both performs it and prints the admitted type, which is copied verbatim into formal.statement.
